dependencies.required_evidence: Terminal positive q1 A/B qualification and exact complete-package accounting.
The same independently audited causal route descriptors used by Fiber-CTS.
Terminal physical-time FOSSIL atlas receipt on the identical retained-parent population.
Route-conditioned exact virtual continuations have target-bearing parent surprise and beat matched physical-time FOSSIL before native integration.

contract.role: conditional semantic-route exact-recurrence expert operating on noncontiguous virtual history
contract.scientific_question: Do exact continuations recur within an already-decoded template-field route even when physical separation hides them from the global far-history mechanism?

causal_semantics.route: length-delimited template name plus explicit field key or positional field index, completely decoded before the value
causal_semantics.virtual_key: the preceding 16 decoded bytes in the current route's virtual timeline
causal_semantics.prediction: the byte that followed the most recent exact occurrence of that route plus virtual key
causal_semantics.order: lookup and predict before truth; after truth, store truth as the continuation of the prior exact virtual key and advance only the selected route
causal_semantics.no_transmission: no source coordinate, physical or virtual distance, length, route, rank, or copy command is encoded
causal_semantics.overflow: sleep and do not update while the bounded parser or descriptor is invalid

route_bank.record: 128-bit route fingerprint, last 16 virtual bytes, saturated 32-bit support, 64-bit virtual ordinal, and 32-bit validity/generation; the complete packed record is statically asserted to 48 bytes
route_bank.collision: fingerprint mismatch sleeps for the current field and never merges histories; the diagnostic manifest retains canonical descriptors and makes an observed equal-fingerprint unequal-descriptor alias fatal

continuation_table.record: 128-bit route fingerprint, exact 16-byte virtual key, one continuation byte, one saturated support byte, 16-bit validity/generation, and 32-bit most-recent virtual ordinal; the complete packed record is statically asserted to 40 bytes
continuation_table.index: frozen unsigned hash masked to 20 bits
continuation_table.collision: stored route or key mismatch is absence before truth; deterministic most-recent replacement occurs after truth

bounded_state.rule: The exact record layout and all allocations require a source-level proof and measured composite resource receipt.

probability_endpoint.atlas: convert the exact donor byte into causal normalized bit probabilities using the atlas's frozen per-arm bit-position KT correctness calibration
probability_endpoint.native: freeze either the same calibration or one direct distribution before source integration; observing native results may not choose between endpoints
probability_endpoint.sleep: no exact route-key hit means no candidate event
probability_endpoint.parent: the authoritative q1 trajectory is read-only and remains byte-identical in P and K

arms.K: exact parser, routing, lookup, update, allocation, and hashes with no prediction and no parent write
arms.G: current physical-time FOSSIL-MATCH v3 on the same population and parent trace
arms.S: the immediately preceding field route with identical lookup geometry and event count
arms.R: deterministic random route with identical table geometry and update cadence
arms.N: complement the aligned continuation before the identical calibration endpoint
arms.repeat: fresh-process identity of opportunities, predictions, probabilities, table digest, payload, inverse, and resources

authorization.entry: Authorize only when global physical FOSSIL is subscale or redundant and the frozen atlas shows D has target-bearing residual parent surprise and a positive margin over G in every chronological third.
authorization.atlas_gate: At 10M, D ideal gain is at least 40,793 byte-equivalent, D beats G/S/R/N, every chronological third is positive, and at least two preregistered virtual-distance buckets are positive.
authorization.native_gate: One exact opening-10M P/K/G/D/S/R/N finite-coder implementation, inverse, repeat, package, memory, runtime, and dependency closure; D must save at least 40,793 payload bytes and beat G before package cost.
authorization.retirement: If D does not beat physical FOSSIL, matched controls, thirds, or virtual-distance buckets, retire the semantic-distance claim without table-size, route, key-length, support, or endpoint sweep.

promotion_ladder: full 1G A/B exact inverse, deterministic package, resource, provenance, and complete counted score

activation_requirements: q1 is terminally qualified and no exclusive full-1G lease or acquisition lock exists.
The route parser, descriptor witness, virtual update order, table records, hashes, calibration endpoint, controls, populations, schemas, and output set are frozen and content-addressed.
The same-population atlas receipt shows route-conditioned D beats physical-time G under the preregistered gate.
Gamma Mechanism IR proves P/K parent identity and no mechanism-to-parent state write.
The declared allocation passes static admission before build and measured composite guards during every run.
claim_boundary: WIKI-FIBER-FOSSIL is a zero-credit conditional design; no opportunity, probability, archive, inverse, package, or saving has been measured.
An exact virtual match is not a saving when the parent already predicts its continuation well.
The declared sizes are prospective resource bounds, not memory evidence.
The 40,793-byte gates are preregistered target-bearing thresholds, not forecasts.
